nodes.label: Theorem 2
nodes.content: Suppose that  $f:\R^d	o\R$ is an admissible function, is not identically zero, and satisfies: egin{equation}\label{eqn: Cohn-Elkies condition 1}f(x)\leq 0\mbox{ for } \|x\|\geq 1\end{equation} and  egin{equation}\label{eqn: Cohn-Elkies condition 2}\widehat{f}(x)\geq0\mbox{ for all } x\in\R^d.\end{equation} Then the  density of  $d$-dimensional sphere packings is bounded above by $$ rac{f(0)}{\widehat{f}(0)}\cdot  rac{\pi^{ rac{d}{2}}}{2^d\,\Gamma(	extstyle  rac{d}{2}+1)}= rac{f(0)}{\widehat{f}(0)}\cdot \mathrm{Vol}\,B_d(0, rac 12).$$

nodes.label: Proposition 1
nodes.content: The function $a$ defined by \eqref{eqn: a(r) definition} belongs to the Schwartz space and satisfies $$\widehat{a}(x)=a(x). $$

nodes.label: Proposition 2
nodes.content: For $r>\sqrt{2}$ we can express $a(r)$ in the following form  egin{equation}\label{eqn: a double zeroes} a(r)=-4\sin(\pi r^2/2)^2\,\int\limits_{0}^{i\infty}\phi_0\Big( rac{-1}{z}\Big)\,z^2\,e^{\pi i r^2 \,z}\,dz. \end{equation}

otag\end{align} The integral converges absolutely for all $r\in\R_{\geq 0}$.

nodes.label: Proposition 4
nodes.content: We have  egin{equation} a(0)= rac{-i\,8640}{\pi}\qquad a(\sqrt{2})=0\qquad a^\prime(\sqrt{2})= rac{i\,72\sqrt{2}}{\pi}. \end{equation}

nodes.label: Proposition 5
nodes.content: The function $b$ defined by \eqref{eqn: b(r) definition} belongs to the Schwartz space and satisfies $$\widehat{b}(x)=-b(x). $$

nodes.content: We have  egin{equation}\label{eqn: b values} b(0)=0\qquad b(\sqrt{2})=0\qquad b^\prime(\sqrt{2})=2\sqrt{2}\,\pi\,i. \end{equation}

nodes.content:

nodes.label: Theorem 1
nodes.content: No packing of unit balls in Euclidean space $\R^8$ has density greater than that of the $E_8$-lattice packing.
